## Load packages

```{r setup}
pacman::p_load(here, dplyr, tidyr, purrr, stringr, ggplot2, patchwork, readxl, writexl)
here::i_am("05_Mitochondria/03_complex_subunits/a_script/03_complex_subunits.qmd")
```

## Read inputs

Each subunit and assembly factor of complexes I to V, with its training change in each leg, side
by side. From Sam's PR #26 (sc-norton). It is descriptive only: the inference is fry on the
complexes in `02_test_mito`.

`de` is the stage 02 `DEP_matrix`, one row per protein with logFC, p and BH-adjusted p per
contrast. `membership` lists the MitoCarta sets; `complex_tests` holds fry's complex results.

```{r read}
stage <- here("05_Mitochondria", "03_complex_subunits")
de <- read_excel(
  here("02_Differential_Expression", "02_Differential", "c_data", "02_differential.xlsx"),
  "DEP_matrix"
)
membership <- read_excel(
  here("05_Mitochondria", "01_build_mito_sets", "c_data", "01_build_mito_sets.xlsx"),
  "membership"
)
complex_tests <- read_excel(
  here("05_Mitochondria", "02_test_mito", "c_data", "02_test_mito.xlsx"),
  "complex_tests"
)
```

## Collect the subunits

Keep the measured genes of the MitoPathways "CI subunits" to "CV assembly factors", split the set
name into complex and role, and join each gene to its stage 02 row by symbol. Sam's "Other" group
joins them: the MitoPathways "Cytochrome C" and "Respirasome assembly" genes that belong to no
single complex. Rows sort within complex and role by the interaction logFC, BFR minus HLRT.

```{r subunits}
complexes <- c("CI", "CII", "CIII", "CIV", "CV", "Other")
complex_members <- membership |>
  filter(str_detect(set, "^C(I|II|III|IV|V) (subunits|assembly factors)$")) |>
  separate_wider_delim(set, " ", names = c("complex", "role"), too_many = "merge")
other_members <- membership |>
  filter(set %in% c("Cytochrome C", "Respirasome assembly"), !gene %in% complex_members$gene) |>
  mutate(complex = "Other", role = "other")
members <- bind_rows(complex_members, other_members)
subunits <- members |>
  filter(measured) |>
  inner_join(de, by = c(gene = "Genes")) |>
  transmute(
    complex = factor(complex, complexes), role, gene, protein,
    BFR_logFC = `BFR_Post-Pre_logFC`,
    BFR_fdr = `BFR_Post-Pre_adj.P.Val`,
    HLRT_logFC = `HLRT_Post-Pre_logFC`,
    HLRT_fdr = `HLRT_Post-Pre_adj.P.Val`,
    difference = `Modality_x_Time_Interaction_logFC`,
    difference_fdr = `Modality_x_Time_Interaction_adj.P.Val`
  ) |>
  arrange(complex, role, desc(difference))
head(subunits, 3)
```

## The set-level test

A paired t-test across the subunits of a complex counts correlated proteins as independent
replicates and makes p too small. The set-level test is fry on the subunits, standard fit,
interaction contrast, and it goes in the panel titles. Assembly factors have no set test.

```{r interaction-fry}
interaction_fry <- complex_tests |>
  filter(fit == "standard", contrast == "Modality_x_Time_Interaction") |>
  transmute(complex = str_remove(set, " subunits"), fry_fdr = FDR)
interaction_fry
```

## Figures

Three A4 pages go to `b_reports/03_complex_subunits.pdf`, sharing one theme.

```{r theme}
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 9))
theme_update(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
arm_colours <- c(BFR = "#B2182B", HLRT = "#2166AC")
```

Page 1 holds Sam's two summaries, stacked: complex subunits, then assembly factors with "Other".
Each bar is the mean change of a group's measured proteins per leg, with the standard error across
them, and every protein is a point. The standard error describes spread among correlated proteins
and is not a test; the test is fry, whose interaction FDR labels the subunit summary. Axis labels
give measured of all MitoCarta members. The jitter has its own seed, so the points land in the
same place on every run.

```{r summary-page}
group_size <- members |>
  summarise(measured = sum(measured), total = n(), .by = c(complex, role)) |>
  mutate(label = sprintf("%s\n(n = %d/%d)", complex, measured, total))
summary_plot <- function(roles, title, fry) {
  rows <- filter(subunits, role %in% roles) |>
    pivot_longer(c(BFR_logFC, HLRT_logFC), names_to = "arm", values_to = "logFC") |>
    mutate(arm = str_remove(arm, "_logFC"))
  labels <- filter(group_size, role %in% roles)
  ggplot(rows, aes(complex, logFC, fill = arm)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey50") +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "col", position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.7) +
    stat_summary(
      fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.25,
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_point(
      position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8, seed = 1),
      size = 0.9, alpha = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = fry, inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.8,
      aes(complex, Inf, label = paste("fry FDR", signif(fry_fdr, 2))), vjust = 1.5
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = set_names(labels$label, labels$complex)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = arm_colours, name = NULL) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "log2 change, post - pre", title = title)
}
summary_page <- summary_plot("subunits", "Complex subunits, summary by leg", interaction_fry) /
  summary_plot(
    c("assembly factors", "other"), "Assembly factors and other OXPHOS proteins, by leg",
    interaction_fry[0, ]
  )
```

Pages 2 and 3 draw every protein of one role by leg, one panel per complex. Panel titles carry the
protein count and, on the subunit page, fry's interaction FDR.

```{r role-page}
role_page <- function(which_role, title) {
  rows <- filter(subunits, role == which_role)
  fry <- if (which_role == "subunits") interaction_fry else interaction_fry[0, ]
  headers <- rows |>
    count(complex) |>
    left_join(fry, by = "complex") |>
    mutate(panel = if_else(
      is.na(fry_fdr), sprintf("%s (%d)", complex, n),
      sprintf("%s (%d), fry interaction FDR %s", complex, n, signif(fry_fdr, 2))
    ))
  rows |>
    pivot_longer(c(BFR_logFC, HLRT_logFC), names_to = "arm", values_to = "logFC") |>
    mutate(
      arm = str_remove(arm, "_logFC"), gene = factor(gene, unique(rows$gene)),
      panel = headers$panel[match(complex, headers$complex)]
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(gene, logFC, fill = arm)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey50") +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~panel, ncol = 1, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = arm_colours, name = NULL) +
    labs(
      x = NULL, y = "log2 change, post - pre",
      title = title
    ) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 6))
}
```

```{r pdf}
pdf(file.path(stage, "b_reports", "03_complex_subunits.pdf"), width = 8.27, height = 11.69)
walk(
  list(
    summary_page,
    role_page("subunits", "Complex subunits by leg"),
    role_page("assembly factors", "Complex assembly factors by leg")
  ),
  print
)
invisible(dev.off())
```

## Summary

Proteins per complex and role, and how many reach BH FDR < 0.05 in each leg and for the
interaction.

```{r summary}
subunits |>
  summarise(
    proteins = n(), bfr_fdr_05 = sum(BFR_fdr < 0.05), hlrt_fdr_05 = sum(HLRT_fdr < 0.05),
    interaction_fdr_05 = sum(difference_fdr < 0.05), .by = c(role, complex)
  )
```

## Save results

`03_complex_subunits.xlsx` holds the `subunits` table.

```{r write}
write_xlsx(list(subunits = subunits), file.path(stage, "c_data", "03_complex_subunits.xlsx"))
```
